schema: create table Student(StuID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,LName VARCHAR(12),Fname VARCHAR(12),Age INTEGER,Sex VARCHAR(1),Major INTEGER,Advisor INTEGER,mã thành phố VARCHAR(3)) ;
